title: Phase 2 new-data hypotheses, phase 3 exposure ensemble, phase 5 go/no-go for BTC/ETH
why: Every tested method used only price and volume. Signals can only improve with information that is not in the chart. All rules, sources, windows and criteria are fixed here before any of this data is downloaded.
timing: exposure for day d is decided only from data available at the close of day d-1 (timing.py convention); daily macro series use the last value dated on or before d-1; the FRED dollar index additionally lags 7 days for publication delay
honesty_note: discovery/confirmation windows are the same calendar windows used by prereg_btc_eth_timing.json; these are new hypothesis classes on new data, but the price path is not new. A forward test (phase 5) is therefore required before any real-money use.

phase2_hypotheses.N1_STABLE_GROWTH: total stablecoin supply (DefiLlama, all stablecoins, USD) at d-1 above its value 30 days earlier -> long, else cash (new dollars entering crypto)
phase2_hypotheses.N2_MVRV_NOT_HOT: CoinMetrics CapMVRVCur of the asset at d-1 above its 80th percentile of the prior 730 days -> cash, else long (market value far above realised value = overheated)
phase2_hypotheses.N3_DVOL_CALM: Deribit DVOL of the asset, 7-day mean at d-1, below its 70th percentile of the prior 365 days -> long, else cash (stress regimes lose)
phase2_hypotheses.N4_SPX_RISK_ON: S&P 500 (stooq ^spx) last close on or before d-1 above its 200-trading-day average -> long, else cash (global risk appetite)
phase2_hypotheses.N5_DXY_WEAK: FRED DTWEXBGS broad dollar index, last value dated on or before d-8, below its 100-observation average -> long, else cash (weak dollar = liquidity)
phase2_hypotheses.N6_FNG_NOT_GREEDY: alternative.me Fear & Greed 7-day mean at d-1 above 75 -> cash, else long (extreme greed)

phase2_rule.ADOPT: discovery timing edge > 0 with Romano-Wolf p_adj < 0.10 across these 12 tests (6 x 2 assets, 30-day blocks) AND confirmation timing edge > 0 AND confirmation Sharpe after costs >= buy-and-hold Sharpe
phase2_rule.CONSISTENT: edge > 0 in both windows without the full rule: reported, not used

phase3_ensemble.E1_MOM3: exposure = mean of three momentum votes decided on Mondays: Sunday close above the close 14, 28 and 56 days earlier (0, 1/3, 2/3 or 1 of capital)
phase3_ensemble.E2_MOM3_PLUS: exposure = mean of E1's three votes plus one vote per ADOPTED phase-2 signal for that asset; not run if nothing is adopted
phase3_ensemble.USE_RULE: a model replaces the single 28-day rule (H3) in the app only if, in the confirmation window, its Sharpe >= H3's Sharpe AND its max drawdown <= H3's max drawdown; otherwise H3 stays

phase5_go_no_go.GO_small: forward return of the displayed model >= buy-and-hold return - 5 percentage points AND forward max drawdown <= buy-and-hold max drawdown, per asset
phase5_go_no_go.brake: if at any time the forward drawdown of the model exceeds 1.5x its worst confirmation-window drawdown, the app stops showing it as usable and says why

no_changes_after_seeing_results: nothing above is changed after data is downloaded

amendments.change: N4_SPX_RISK_ON data source: stooq ^spx now sits behind an anti-bot proof-of-work challenge, which will not be bypassed; the same index (S&P 500 daily close) is taken from FRED series SP500 instead. The rule is unchanged; FRED values are used only if dated on or before d-1.
